title: Deadline and Drop
author: Ivo Nystrom
blurb: Ansel Kavanagh, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
